_comment: The scoring, written once. The browser inlines this at build time (scripts/build.py) and the game server gets a copy through scripts/generate_worker_rules.py, so the score you see and the score the board keeps cannot drift apart.
_picture: Priced by how much each gives away. An item is worth 100, so an anagram at 65 still leaves 35 on the table - worth buying when you are stuck, never worth buying on spec.
_live: The round is played by everyone at once. The host starts it, the server owns the clock, and every client works out the time left from the server's own now - so nobody gets a longer five minutes because their laptop clock is wrong.
